title: General.
officialText:
The provisions of this section shall apply to temporary tents, grandstands, platforms, reviewing stands, outdoor
bandstands, stages and similar miscellaneous structures erected for a period of 90 days or less. Such structures may be constructed of
wood whether located inside or outside of the fire districts.
